headline: WeBleedOrangeAndBlue tops the town; Super Troopers survive by 0.92
lede: Week 3 came in loud on both ends, pardner: WeBleedOrangeAndBlue struck the richest vein in the territory at 131.94, while densmen limped into camp with 63.81. Down at the other end of the street, Super Troopers and Zihuatanejo settled it by 0.92, which is close enough to hear each other breathe. Long Howie and Super Troopers ride out of here at 3-0, and e-mans revenge and HAWKSRULE are still huntin' their first.
paragraphs: Warthogs handed densmen the widest whippin' of the week, 103.54 to 63.81, a 39.73 gap you could drive a wagon train through. Jordan Love led the Warthogs with 23.64 while Kayshon Boutte mustered 1.85, and even then it was never close. densmen got 13.71 from Jalen Hurts and a flat 0.0 from Dallas Goedert, which is the kind of goose egg that ruins a fella's Sunday supper. Both outfits left silver in the dirt: 18.0 for Warthogs with the Bears defense sittin' on the bench at 22.0, and 24.0 for densmen.

WeBleedOrangeAndBlue posted the high score of the whole territory, 131.94, and sent HAWKSRULE home at 99.05. Jahmyr Gibbs did the heavy haulin' with 34.0, more than enough to cover Hunter Henry's 0.65. HAWKSRULE got a fine 28.08 out of Jaxon Smith-Njigba but started the Cowboys defense for 0.0, and now sits 0-3 with 3 straight losses on the ledger.

sisu beat Jrod 122.37 to 105.58 and still managed to leave the best part of the claim unworked. Bo Nix put up 24.27 for sisu, but Jacoby Brissett sat on the bench for 34.0, and a better lineup was worth 32.88 more. Jrod got a whale of a day from Bijan Robinson at 34.25 and it went for naught, with Juwan Johnson's 18.85 watchin' from the pine.

Aeil took it from Dart Star Orchestra 109.91 to 98.19, Kirk Cousins leadin' the way with 25.31. Dart Star Orchestra had the finest defender in the league this week in Nakobe Dean at 15.5, and it did not matter one lick, because Geno Smith rode the bench for 35.62 and a better lineup would have added 42.63. Aeil also owns the week's tall tale: James Cook III ripped 15 yards or more on 10% of his carries, best of the 38 qualifying runners in the land.

Long Howie stayed unbeaten at 3-0, edging e-mans revenge 124.23 to 113.05. Jared Goff posted 24.08 for Long Howie, and Justin Jefferson's 2.4 somehow did not sink the wagon. e-mans revenge got 24.85 from Matthew Stafford, cashed a check for 4th place money, and still fell to 0-3, with Aaron Rodgers parked on the bench for 22.54.

Scott's Hype held off Norskes U Betcha 108.77 to 100.29, riding the Vikings defense for 30.0, which is a rare thing to see leadin' a roster. Norskes U Betcha earned the worst lineup in the territory this week: a better arrangement was worth 43.96, with the Jaguars defense sittin' idle at 29.0 while the Eagles defense started and gave back 3.0. Trevor Lawrence's 21.29 deserved better company.

Justin's Bad Team squeezed past Jack Attack 100.73 to 98.38, a margin of 2.35 that came down to loose change. Kenneth Walker III carried Justin's Bad Team with 20.05 and the outfit left almost nothing behind, just 2.7 on the table. Jack Attack got 19.5 from George Kittle, a 0.0 from Oronde Gadsden, and had Patrick Mahomes watchin' from the bench at 19.37, with 22.59 more available to a sharper hand.

Closest race in town: Super Troopers 83.49, Zihuatanejo 82.57, decided by 0.92. Brock Purdy put 28.64 on the board for Super Troopers, who go to 3-0 despite leavin' 31.4 behind and Brock Bowers stuck on the bench at 16.8. Zihuatanejo got 20.42 from Lamar Jackson and can chew on Sam Darnold's 34.63, which never left the wagon.
sign_off: 10 weeks left in the regular season and 8 seats at the playoff table. Plenty of trail yet, so check your lineups before the wagon rolls.
purse: The commissioner's purse goes 4 deep: WeBleedOrangeAndBlue takes $40 on 131.94, Long Howie collects $20 on 124.23, sisu pockets $10 on 122.37, and e-mans revenge grabs $5 on 113.05. Second week in the money for sisu, and a fine consolation for e-mans revenge, who got paid and beat nobody.
